title: Build and fill a safe raised bed
subcategory: Build and fill a safe raised bed
summary: Create a drainable growing area where native soil is poor or access is limited.
content:
Create a drainable growing area where native soil is poor or access is limited.

Use this as an offline field guide: verify the crop variety, local weather, water quality, soil history and product labels before acting. Complete the steps in order, record the result, and stop when contamination, an unidentified plant, uncontrolled disease or unsafe preservation conditions are suspected.
steps: Choose a stable level location with suitable sun, water access and no buried utility conflict.
Use durable untreated or food-garden-appropriate materials; avoid unknown reclaimed chemical containers or treated timber.
Provide depth suitable for intended roots and a route for excess water to escape.
Fill with a known clean soil-compost blend rather than pure compost.
Settle, water, check drainage and plant a small test area before full use.
warnings: Do not grow food in soil suspected of sewage, fuel, industrial chemical, heavy-metal or lead contamination until it is professionally assessed.
Do not apply fresh manure to ready-to-eat crops; follow local agricultural and food-safety guidance.
common_mistakes: Planting or processing the entire supply before a small trial.
Changing several variables at once, making failure impossible to diagnose.
Relying on appearance alone instead of labels, dates, measurements and records.
alternatives: Reduce the operation to one test container or one small batch.
Use fresh produce immediately instead of attempting preservation when safe equipment or a tested method is unavailable.
failure_signs: Continued wilting, rot, mould, abnormal odour, contamination evidence, uncontrolled pest spread or results that contradict the tested method.
when_not_to_use: Do not use this guide to override an official recall, plant-health order, pesticide label, water restriction, food-safety notice or professional diagnosis.
short_term: Protect the current crop or food batch, label the uncertainty, separate it from safe stock and record what happened.
long_term: Build a seasonal log with varieties, water use, soil inputs, yields, pest observations, processing methods and losses.
if_method_fails: Stop scaling up. Isolate the affected plants or food, return to a verified small trial and seek local agricultural or food-safety advice.
environment_notes: Adapt for Mediterranean heat, local frost, wind exposure, water scarcity, balcony load limits and the actual microclimate.
